title: Nova Web Dashboard — Part 1: Auth, Admin, Core Pages, Settings

overview.name: Nova
overview.purpose: Central Flask web dashboard for every bot (LionByteGG, BoilerCraft, LionShift, LionBeats) plus the Arena Kiosk system. Single login, permission-gated sidebar sections per bot.
overview.entry: run.py (waitress WSGI in production: python run.py --production)

databases.arena_db.py: SQLite arena signins/students/watchlist/flags (shared data dir, arena.db)

user_types.dashboard_user: Created via /admin panel, belongs to a permission group, session['dashboard_user'] + session['dashboard_permissions']
user_types.legacy_login: Old-style admin login (security-code based), full access to everything, session['authenticated']+session['legacy_login']
user_types.bearer_token: API-only auth: 'Authorization: Bearer {SECURITY_CODE}' header, used by external tools/tests

decorators.login_required: Page routes — redirects to /login if not authenticated (dashboard_user OR legacy)
decorators.api_auth_required: API routes — 401 JSON if not authenticated (dashboard_user OR legacy OR bearer token)
decorators.page_permission_required(key): Page routes — checks resolved permission set (OR logic if list given); full-access users bypass; redirects to smart_landing on deny
decorators.api_perm_required(key): API routes — same logic, returns 403 JSON on deny

permission_functions.has_perm(key): True for full-access users; else checks resolved permission set
permission_functions.get_user_perms(): Returns ALL_PERMISSIONS for full-access users, else session['dashboard_permissions']
permission_functions._perm_keys(key): Normalizes a string or iterable of permission keys to a list
permission_functions.inject_user_perms() [context processor]: Exposes user_perms, has_perm(), is_captain, account_role to every Jinja template

permission_naming_convention.section.NAME: Shows a top-level nav section (e.g. section.lionbyte, section.arena)
permission_naming_convention.page.NAME: Can view a specific page (required for its nav link to render)
permission_naming_convention.NAME.action: Specific action permission within a feature (e.g. moderation.warn, arena.manage)

json_io_helpers.load_json_file(filepath, default=None): safe_json_load() — thread-safe, returns default on missing/invalid file
json_io_helpers.safe_queue_append(filepath, item): Thread-safe append to a JSON array file
json_io_helpers.queue_discord_notification(data): Appends {status:'pending', queued_at, ...data} to discord_notification_queue.json for the LionByteGG bot to consume
json_io_helpers.log_activity(action, category, details,: Appends to the unified activity log (max 1000 entries), captures user/ip/path/method

helper_functions.get_bot_stats(): Reads bot_status.json (if <2min old) else falls back to live bot instance or offline
helper_functions.get_moderator_name()/get_moderator_id(): Current session user's display name/id for audit trails
helper_functions.load_guest_times(): All active guest passes from GUEST_TIMES_DIR
helper_functions.delete_schedule_images(attachments): Removes local schedule image files (ignores http URLs)
helper_functions.transform_attachments_to_urls(data): Converts filenames to /schedule-images/{filename} or CDN URL
helper_functions._sync_automod_bg(flagged_words): Runs AutoMod sync in a background thread
helper_functions._is_full_access_user(): True for admin dashboard users or legacy login

routes_auth_and_landing.does: redirect to /home if logged in else /login
GET shows form; POST validates via auth_db.authenticate_user(), sets session, logs 'login', redirects to /home
AJAX pre-flight credential check with NO session creation — returns {valid,display_name} or {valid:false,error}

routes_auth_and_landing.returns: current user object (dashboard or legacy) or 401

routes_auth_and_landing.does: Full-access users -> /dashboard (or /admin if admin.panel); else checks each bot section in priority order (lionbyte, boilercraft, lionshift, lionbeats, arena) and lands on the first accessible page; falls back to /login?error=no_dashboard_access

routes_admin_panel.does: User/group/permission management UI, bot control panel, system configuration

routes_admin_panel.note: refreshes own session perms if editing self

routes_admin_panel.safeguards: cannot delete self, cannot delete last admin

routes_admin_panel.returns: full list of permission key strings for building checkboxes

core_page_routes.shows: bot status, quick stats, recent activity, nav cards, search bar
user record search/filter, issue warnings, bulk actions, export
member list, search, full profiles, send DM, add notes, guest status
open/closed tickets, filters, responses, assign staff
arena hours, team role mapping, esports games list, bot activity, flagged words
unified activity log with filters + CSV export

core_page_routes.note: see chapter 06 for the full roster/varsity API

bot_control_api.does: GET current bot presence text; POST updates bot_activity.json and queues a Discord presence update

logging_and_stats_api.does: Aggregated feed of moderation + ticket + varsity + activity events, newest-first, capped 500

logging_and_stats_api.query: category, action, source, target_id, limit, offset

logging_and_stats_api.returns: bot status + violation/kick/ban totals + active guest count
member breakdown, moderation totals, varsity pending/approved/denied, top roles

logging_and_stats_api.does: Cross-search members, user_records, guests, varsity registrations — max 10 results

logging_and_stats_api.returns: static reference list of all bot slash commands grouped by category

logging_and_stats_api.does: GET returns bannable/kickable/warning lists; POST add/remove a word (lowercased) and triggers background AutoMod sync

user_records_and_members_api.returns: all users' records enriched with member cache info + counts
member + records + guest_time + varsity_registrations + stats summary

user_records_and_members_api.does: Queues an async DM via the bot
Adds a violation record + queues a warning DM

user_records_and_members_api.returns: all active/expired guest passes with days_remaining

settings_api.does: POST also queues a bot settings-reload notification
Esports game titles used by varsity registration dropdowns

template_purposes.dashboard.html: Landing overview with patch-notes banner and quick stats
template_purposes.settings.html: Arena hours, team roles, games list, flagged words, feature toggles
